Overview

Danlí is a city in EP with a population of 100,000. The tobacco capital of Honduras, an eastern city known for its cigar production and mountain scenery. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
